Appellant :- Amar

Counsel for Appellant :- Deepesh Kumar Ojha
Counsel for Respondent :- A.G.A.,Basdeo Nishad
Hon'ble Manoj Bajaj,J.
(Order on Suspension of Sentence Application)

Applicant-Appellant, namely, Amar has applied for suspension of sentence during pendency of the appeal, arising against the judgment of conviction and order of sentence dated 21.12.2023 passed by Special Additional Sessions Judge (POCSO Act),
Muzaffarnagar in Sessions Case No. 1366 of 2023, thereby convicting the appellant under Sections 363, 376, 366 IPC and Section 5/6 POCSO Act, and has been sentenced for commission of various offences along with fine.

entities.text:
Special Additional Sessions Judge (POCSO Act),
Muzaffarnagar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The applicant-convict was prosecuted through Case Crime No. 113 of 2023, under Sections 363, 376,
366 IPC and Section 5/6 POCSO Act, registered at Police Station Shahpur, District Muzaffarnagar.
After arguing for some time, prayer has been made by learned counsel for the applicant to withdraw this application.
